topic: A planned job queue that resumes after a failed render

claims.statement: The proposed application should save successful stages and resume unfinished work after a crash.

scenes.narration: Imagine finishing an edit, losing power, and having to start over. Our proposed workflow should save each finished step, so a retry continues from the missing piece.
scenes.visual_intent: Original animated queue diagram: completed stages remain green while the unfinished render resumes.
